//: ROOT-LEVEL config for a monorepo: app/ (Vite SPA) + contracts/ (Foundry).
HISTORY, because both mistakes are easy to repeat:
1. The very first deploy 404'd on every path. Vercel builds from the repo root unless told
otherwise, and the root has no index.html.
2. The first attempt at THIS file then broke a build that had started working. It declared
`bun install` / `bun run build`, but Vercel only selects Bun when it sees a bun.lockb or
a `packageManager` field in package.json - neither exists here - so it was calling a
binary that was not provisioned. Worse, it also set installCommand to an `echo`, which
meant nothing was installed at all. Commands below use npm, which Vercel always has.
Everything is relative to the REPO ROOT, hence the app/ prefixes.
buildCommand: cd app && npm install && npm run build
//rewrites: The negative lookahead is load-bearing. An SPA needs unknown paths to fall through to
index.html, but a naive /(.*) swallows /api/* too: the upload endpoint would return the HTML
shell and fail with a JSON parse error pointing nowhere near the cause.
